# Smarter Weather Developer Platform

> Weather data for apps and AI agents: a REST API (api.smarterweather.com), a
> hosted weather MCP server (mcp.smarterweather.com), and an agent-first
> onboarding MCP server (mcp.developers.smarterweather.com) that can sign you
> up, mint API keys, and configure your client — all from inside an AI agent.

Agents: start here. There is nothing to install. Call
https://api.smarterweather.com/v1/weather?lat=41.66&lon=-91.53 with no key;
the 401 is an RFC 9457 problem whose `next_steps` member names where to get a
key (`recommended` first). Send the human to
https://developers.smarterweather.com/dashboard/api-keys (free, no card, shown
once), write the key to `.env` as SMARTERWEATHER_API_KEY, add `.env` to
`.gitignore`, never echo it into chat or a commit, and call again with
`Authorization: Bearer sw_live_*`. If the client speaks MCP, connect
anonymously to https://mcp.developers.smarterweather.com (Streamable HTTP) and
call get_plans / sign_up; account-scoped tools (create_api_key, configure_mcp)
unlock after OAuth 2.1 sign-in; remove that server afterwards. Agents with a
wallet can pay per call on the weather MCP via x402 instead.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](https://github.com/smarterweather/developer/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md): three requests from zero to a live forecast call, then the MCP path
- [REST API guide](https://github.com/smarterweather/developer/blob/main/docs/rest-api.md): auth, endpoints, rate-limit headers, pagination
- [OpenAPI specification](https://github.com/smarterweather/developer/blob/main/openapi.yaml): full machine-readable contract for api.smarterweather.com
- [Weather MCP server guide](https://github.com/smarterweather/developer/blob/main/docs/mcp-weather.md): hosted endpoint, the 29-tool catalog (forecasts, alerts, outlooks, raw dataset queries, rendered radar/satellite map + sounding imagery), stdio bridge (@smarterweather/mcp-weather)
- [Onboarding MCP server guide](https://github.com/smarterweather/developer/blob/main/docs/mcp-onboarding.md): agent-first signup, key provisioning, client config (@smarterweather/mcp-onboarding)
- [Agent integration guide](https://github.com/smarterweather/developer/blob/main/docs/agent-integration.md): patterns for wiring Smarter Weather into AI agents
- [Error model](https://github.com/smarterweather/developer/blob/main/docs/errors.md): RFC 9457 problem details, the `next_steps` extension, and retry semantics
- [SDKs](https://github.com/smarterweather/developer/blob/main/docs/sdks.md): official client libraries
